hypothesis: An explicit negative-case matrix during criteria preparation reduces late validation and routing defects without relaxing quality.

analysis.hypothesis_result: Not supported in this pair: stable had zero late validation/routing findings; candidate had two validation findings despite its preimplementation negative-case matrix. Both findings were corrected and independently reverified. This does not establish that the practice causes regressions in general.
analysis.final_quality: Both complete applications independently pass all ten mandatory API/browser criteria, eleven additional API groups, five additional UI scenarios, original five JSON edges and fourteen expanded POST/PUT JSON/Unicode checks.

correction_classification.stable: One self-check source revision fixed a test-owned SQLite connection cleanup failure; no independently found application defect.
correction_classification.candidate: One self-check revision fixed an application SQLite connection leak; one independent-finding revision fixed strict-JSON and invalid-Unicode validation. Total two source correction revisions; two late findings closed in one revision.
correction_classification.candidate_other_retries: Separate search-fixture expectation, browser-save wait, UUID scratch collision and initial selected-vs-whole-digest registration rejection were retained. They are not additional application-source correction revisions.
correction_classification.reviewer_other_retries: One stable supplementary UI route-glob correction; one retrospective provenance newline-normalization probe; restricted trusted-wrapper socket attempt repeated with proper capability. These are not application defects.

analysis.time_scope: Prospective monotonic dispatch-to-completion stage intervals including tool/controller overhead; lead sums include actual correction stages. Review times include asymmetric suite setup and symmetric follow-up testing performed during candidate review. They are not inference-only, matched causal review times, or additive lifecycle time.
analysis.baseline_environment_retries: Four recorded environment retries retained in lead implementation interval; not subtracted retrospectively. Canonical-only trusted ADA regression was separately verified without generated app host execution.
analysis.telemetry: Provider tokens, calls, provider session totals and cost unavailable; null, not estimated. Human interventions, clarifications, manual recoveries and user-delegated testing are zero in each recorded run.
analysis.historical_provenance_limitation: Candidate first self-check whole-source before digest was reconstructed retrospectively. Independent selected-set reconstruction now matches the contemporaneous aggregate selected-file digest, but no contemporaneous full per-file manifest existed; do not label the full before digest prospective. Final independently reviewed source and independent-finding correction are freshly bound.
limitations: One stable-first pair, different fresh Leads, same inherited model/tools, public known tests, reused Reviewer and prose negative-case overlap in stable preparation limit causal inference.
